questions.stem: A 1000 kg car travelling at 10 m/s collides with a stationary 1000 kg car. They stick together. What is their combined velocity after the collision?
questions.explanation: Conservation of momentum: (1000)(10) + (1000)(0) = (1000 + 1000)(v). So 10000 = 2000v, giving v = 5 m/s. The combined mass moves at half the original speed.
